name: submit-a-print-enquiry
success_message: Thank you - we've received your enquiry and will follow up shortly.
title: Submit a Print Enquiry

web_form_fields.description: Enter the company or organization requesting the quotation.
web_form_fields.label: Company Name

web_form_fields.description: The person Golden Arrow should contact about this enquiry.
web_form_fields.label: Contact Name

web_form_fields.description: A phone or WhatsApp number where Golden Arrow can reach you.
web_form_fields.label: Phone

web_form_fields.description: Choose the closest option. Select Other if your product is not listed.
web_form_fields.label: Product Type
web_form_fields.options:
Folding Carton
Business Card
Flyer
Sticker
Other

web_form_fields.description: Enter the number of finished pieces required, for example 1,000 boxes or 5,000 flyers.
web_form_fields.label: How many do you need?

web_form_fields.description: Briefly describe what you need, or tell us which details you would like Golden Arrow to recommend.
web_form_fields.label: Tell us about your job

web_form_fields.description: Share any details you already know, or leave these blank and Golden Arrow will help you choose.
web_form_fields.label: Additional details (optional)

web_form_fields.description: Enter the final width after cutting or folding. Leave blank if you are unsure.
web_form_fields.label: Finished Width (cm)

web_form_fields.description: Enter the final height after cutting or folding. Leave blank if you are unsure.
web_form_fields.label: Finished Height (cm)

web_form_fields.description: Choose whether the design is printed on one face or on both faces.
web_form_fields.label: Printed Sides

web_form_fields.description: Leave blank if you are unsure. Full-colour printing is normally 4 colours.
web_form_fields.label: Colours on Front

web_form_fields.description: Leave blank for one-sided printing or if you are unsure.
web_form_fields.label: Colours on Back

web_form_fields.description: Example: 350gsm ivory board, glossy paper, or 'please recommend'.
web_form_fields.label: Paper / Material Preference

web_form_fields.description: Example: lamination, die cutting, folding, gluing, foil, or special packing.
web_form_fields.label: Finishing Requirements

web_form_fields.description: Your preferred delivery date. Golden Arrow will confirm availability in the quotation.
web_form_fields.label: When do you need it?

web_form_fields.description: Optional: attach your design, dieline, sample photo, PDF, or any useful reference.
web_form_fields.label: Artwork or Reference File
